2.desc: When an ally character uses a Follow-Up ATK, the wearer gains 1 stack of "Merit," stacking up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s). Each stack of "Merit" increases the DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATKs by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. When there are <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stacks, additionally increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
